description: Subdomain takeover check: lists up to 10 subdomains seen in certificate transparency logs for a domain (Cert Spotter), fetches each over HTTPS, and flags pages that show a known 'unclaimed service' message (GitHub Pages, S3, Heroku, Fastly). Looks at the page text only, not DNS records, so it can miss dangling records that show no such message. Choose this tool for: Subdomain takeover check: lists up to 10 subdomains seen. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_whale_transaction_monitor (Large transfers on Ethereum in the latest 1 to 10 blocks); agent_intel_agent_json_schema_guard (Checks an agent's JSON output against a JSON Schema). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
